question: In each league, considering all seasons, which single team has the fewest total match wins based on comparing home and away goals, including teams with zero wins, ensuring that if multiple teams tie for the fewest wins, only one team is returned for each league?
sql:
-- Final query with all leagues
WITH team_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        m.home_team_api_id as team_api_id,
        CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as won
    FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        m.away_team_api_id as team_api_id,
        CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as won
    FROM Match m
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        team_api_id,
        CAST(SUM(won) AS INTEGER) as total_wins
    FROM team_matches
    GROUP BY league_id, team_api_id
)
SELECT 
    l.name as league_name,
    t.team_long_name,
    tw.total_wins
FROM team_wins tw
JOIN League l ON tw.league_id = l.id
JOIN Team t ON tw.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tw.league_id ORDER BY tw.total_wins ASC, t.team_long_name ASC) = 1
ORDER BY l.name

function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql": "-- Step 1: Count wins per team per league
WITH team_matches AS (
    -- Home team perspective
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        m.home_team_api_id as team_api_id,
        CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as won
    FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    -- Away team perspective
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        m.away_team_api_id as team_api_id,
        CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as won
    FROM Match m
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        team_api_id,
        SUM(won) as total_wins
    FROM team_matches
    GROUP BY league_id, team_api_id
)
SELECT 
    l.name as league_name,
    t.team_long_name,
    tw.total_wins
FROM team_wins tw
JOIN League l ON tw.league_id = l.id
JOIN Team t ON tw.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
ORDER BY l.name, tw.total_wins, t.team_long_name

-- Final query with all leagues
WITH team_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        m.home_team_api_id as team_api_id,
        CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as won
    FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        m.away_team_api_id as team_api_id,
        CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as won
    FROM Match m
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        team_api_id,
        CAST(SUM(won) AS INTEGER) as total_wins
    FROM team_matches
    GROUP BY league_id, team_api_id
)
SELECT 
    l.name as league_name,
    t.team_long_name,
    tw.total_wins
FROM team_wins tw
JOIN League l ON tw.league_id = l.id
JOIN Team t ON tw.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tw.league_id ORDER BY tw.total_wins ASC, t.team_long_name ASC) = 1
ORDER BY l.name
